standingRisks.details: Two high-severity transitive advisories, both with no patched upstream release. The owner accepted temporary dispositions on 2026-10-07 based on documented non-reachability. Both remain installed, both vulnerable code paths remain present on disk, and neither is resolved or remediated. pnpm audit --audit-level=high still exits non-zero and is still reported as FAIL. Re-review if any review trigger in the register fires.

auditPolicy.futureTask: Implement a controlled mechanism distinguishing reviewed temporary exceptions from new vulnerabilities, without hiding the raw audit result. Not built during Stage 0 closure.

validation.smokeNote: First run in the analysis session failed the api fail-fast assertion at scripts/smoke.mjs:62 (child still running at the fixed 10s deadline at scripts/smoke.mjs:60, exitCode null instead of 1). Direct and isolated spawn/poll reproductions behaved correctly and exited 1 in about one second. Four subsequent full smoke runs passed all six assertions. Most likely Windows first-exec latency; root cause not conclusively determined. Implementation deliberately not changed. Hosted Linux CI has not validated this behaviour.
